summary: Example task backs up the Dell OS6 config with os6_config backup: yes and registers the location.
questions: How do I back up a Dell OS6 switch config?

answer_card.title: Back up Dell OS6 config
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config (dellos6)
  dellemc.os6.os6_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_dellso6_location
  when: ansible_network_os == 'dellemc.os6.os6'
```
